question: A pyramid is placed on a cube of side 10 cm such that the base of the pyramid is completely aligned with the top face of the cube. The altitude of the pyramid is thrice the side of the cube. Find the volume of the entire object.
solution:
**Given:**

A pyramid is placed on a cube of side 10 cm such that the base of the pyramid is completely aligned with the top face of the cube.

The altitude of the pyramid is thrice the side of the cube.

**Formula used:**

Volume of Cube (V꜀ᵤbₑ) = side³

Volume of Pyramid (Vₚyᵣₐₘᵢd) = (1/3) × base area × height
